# Teamulate

> Teamulate builds autonomous AI marketing departments for B2B companies.

- Site: https://teamulate.ca
- Contact: contact@teamulate.ca
- Founder: Chris Momchilov
- Location: Barrie, Ontario, Canada

## What we do

Teamulate is a founder-led, AI-operated marketing department. Routine work stays in guardrails. Tenant 0 is Teamulate marketing itself with the same system.

## What humans still approve

Spend, send, and publish. The owner keeps passwords and payments.

## What we do not claim

No public prices. No testimonials or customer logos. No guaranteed ROI. No 24/7 SLA. No advertised agent count. HubSpot is not wired. Research cost tables are pending until sources are in-repo.
